display_name: 화이트 원형 테이블과 타일 바닥의 공간감 항공샷

composition.subject_anchor_priority: one complete product sits just below center on the right-dominant round white table; keep the table edge and the left floor wedge visible
asymmetry_sources: large circular table entering from the right
narrow gray tiled-floor wedge on the left
broad partial shadows cast by unseen room elements

environment.background_plane: one large matte warm-neutral white circular tabletop above a gray tiled cafe floor visible only as a narrow left wedge
environment.surface_character: plain lightly textured matte white table; no fabric weave, coaster, napkin, paper or decorative prop
environment.sun_patch_shape: broad irregular soft-edged tonal patches from off-frame window obstructions, never a crisp leaf or furniture silhouette

lighting.source: one large upper-left window diffused by room air and partial off-frame architecture or furniture
lighting.shadow_description: a compact attached product shadow plus broad low-density environmental shadows crossing both floor and table from objects outside the frame
lighting.ambient_fill: neutral room bounce that keeps white-table texture and gray-floor depth readable
lighting.highlight_behavior: soft protected white highlights with table texture, cup rim and beverage surface retained
lighting.shadow_temperature: neutral to faintly cool relative to the warm-neutral table

capture.shadow_processing: retain the spatial separation between elevated tabletop, receding floor and off-frame room volume
capture.local_texture: retain ceramic or source-container construction, beverage identity, ice and toppings without artificial microcontrast

human_rendering.skin_texture: not applicable because no hand is active
human_rendering.light_response: not applicable because no hand is active

material_rules.glass: in source-family mode rebuild a simple glass in the same broad family and material under the target overhead camera; exact source height, taper, sidewall geometry and branding are not invariants. In adopt-reference mode reconstruct only the versioned opaque white ceramic mug. Keep rim, ice, liquid and attached shadow physically connected
material_rules.plastic: in source-family mode rebuild a simple plastic cup in the same broad family and material under the target overhead camera and never add an unverified lid or straw; in adopt-reference mode obey the separate versioned opaque ceramic container contract

coupling_rules: Product, table, floor and environmental shadows belong to one upper-left window exposure.
The curved table edge and receding floor grout jointly communicate camera height and room depth.
The product stays fully on the table and owns one attached contact shadow.
Only the declared cup design may transfer; reference beverage, latte art, exact shadow silhouette and exact pixel layout are excluded.
forbidden: fabric, coaster, napkin, saucer or placemat
bread, spoon, flower, book, phone or decorative prop
visible chair, plant or furniture body
flat white seamless background with no floor wedge
crisp graphic sunlight or copied shadow silhouette
copied reference coffee, crema or latte art

hard_fail: the round table edge or left gray floor wedge disappears
floor grout does not recede or the table reads as a flat background
broad off-frame environmental shadow atmosphere is absent
fabric, coaster, napkin, saucer or decorative prop appears
product is cropped, floats or lacks an attached contact shadow
reference coffee, latte art, text or exact shadow silhouette leaks
product inherits the oblique source camera instead of the target overhead camera
cup rim is strongly elliptical or too much sidewall is visible
beverage color, syrup or fruit appears on an opaque cup exterior or base
